summary: Static-window link remains unqualified on Windows. Profile sash.win32.interactive/0.0.2 links the counter with one heading, one integer edit, one button, one checked D1 addition, permitted copy, denied paste, Enter activation, and class unregister on close. The new value is stored only when the result text reads back as that value. A denied cut also drops Shift+Delete. This counter omits cut, so the system cut command remains. Executable launch is BLOCKED. Scenes without a gestures block stay on sash.win32.interactive/0.0.1.

static_window_link.prior_record_note: Size and entry RVA match the 14 November 2026 record. The SHA-256 does not. Byte-for-byte reproduction was not demonstrated. R1 and R2 remain NOT_RUN.

interactive_clipboard_link.prior_record_note: The prior image linked the same scene before a denied cut dropped Shift+Delete. This scene still does not author cut.
interactive_clipboard_link.note: Copy is allowed. Paste is denied on the edit. Cut was not authored, so the system cut command remains on this image. A scene that denies cut also drops Shift+Delete before the edit changes. Delete without Shift is not a cut. Enter activates the button. Space is delivered to the focused control. Close unregisters the window class. A failed message pump destroys the window first. The result text is written before the value and revision are stored. The count changes only when that text reads back as the new value. A different readback restores the previous result text while the window is live. A nested activation during that write is ignored. A release that starts during that write drops the commit. A failed text update leaves the previous value. The image was not launched.
